Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2209.11711v3. Human pairwise-ranking/genetic prompt optimization and synthetic-gold assumptions establish evaluation data workflow. SelectedStableDiffusion settings and relative aesthetic judgments remain explicit. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors cannot conclude the discovered set is optimal because genetic search can converge locally; rank-based metrics are relative and insensitive to convergence, and QC assumed DALL-E Mini images were less appealing.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

A genetic algorithm proposed keyword sets; Stable Diffusion generated four images per description/set, humans compared image sets blind to keywords, and Bradley–Terry ranks averaged over descriptions supplied the optimization metric.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The search pool used 100 popular keywords from Stable Diffusion Discord and 72 manually cleaned descriptions from Reddit/Lexica (60 train, 12 validation); Toloka workers below 80% on controls comparing to DALL-E Mini images were suspended.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

After 56 search iterations, Table 1 reports the best-training keyword set with mean rank 43.60 on 60 training descriptions and 38.00 on 12 validation descriptions, versus 14.25 and 12.50 for the top 15 popular keywords; higher rank is better among 56 sets.
